laws.rule: Tatra National Park: everyone entering must buy a ticket (at entry points, online or by QR code): zł 11 (concession zł 5.50), 7-day zł 55. Children under 7 and residents of the bordering gminas are free. Dolina Chochołowska is charged separately by a landowners' association, often cash only. (No RBA rate for PLN)
